scope: Only the inspected image versions deployed with the enforced production security contexts; assessments expire and changed versions fail the gate. Not a blanket acceptance of operating-system vulnerabilities.

exceptions.reason: The vulnerable privileged mount helper failure path is not called by this Python service. Production requires UID10001, no privilege escalation, ALL capabilities dropped, read-only root, and RuntimeDefault seccomp. No untrusted mount arguments or subprocess invocation exist in application routes.
